items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral we did commercials

ctx.x: Yeah. That was the hot thing. The Rolling Stones and Beatles kind of thing and still Jackie Cain and Roy Kral we did commercials, we did sort of like that kind of a sound. That was still kind of in vogue, that kind of wordless thing. But the good thing about it, it was like a paid education as far as being a writer, an arranger/orchestrator. Because you’d be doing instrumentations that you would normally not be dealing with. But the best thing was I started writing a lot more for strings. That was the good part…
Well how much input did you have like an ad agency would come to you and say we have to do an ad for toilet paper. Did they — was it your job to think of a melody?
